4855.title: Incomplete skill caches survive failed installation
4855.rootCauseOneLine: Rename collisions discard the completed download without checking the resident cache, so nonempty incomplete trees persist across requests.
4855.proposedFix: Validate a colliding resident tree, preserve complete winners, replace incomplete destinations using the validated temporary tree, and clean up temporary directories on exit.
4855.caveats: Nonempty incomplete caches reproduced; empty directories recover on Linux. Lazy restoration, EIO, and the exact last-used failure are unverified. No live provider session was required.
